findings.title: Early launch cancellation loses the pending Home landscape rebuild
reproduction: Hold the actual scene-load worker through its injected loader callback.
Select Green through the production set_landscape method; the backdrop rebuild is queued.
Call production start_flight and cancel_flight_loading at its first feedback checkpoint.
Release the worker and allow the production rebuild-flush path to run.
findings.impact: Home can keep the previous landscape behind the new selected launch intent after a cancelled launch.
findings.recommendation: Retain a reconciliation obligation keyed to the current Home/world generation until successful departure or a successful rebuild; restore it on cancellation/failure.
acceptance: Busy prefetch, change landscape, Fly, early Cancel, drain.
No-Fly control; multiple selections; failed creation; successful departure; repeated cancellation; Home recreation; shutdown.
Rendered verification with real backdrops and stock assets.
findings.limits: Unmodified production AppRoot methods and field validation; gated loader, stub Home backdrop/preview broker/candidate, overridden setup/process plumbing. Correctness of transition state is reproduced, not a rendered Home frame or race frequency.

findings.title: Cancelled rotorcraft launch constructs and attaches a candidate after the prefetch drain
reproduction: Start the fixed-wing Home scene worker and hold it at the injected loader callback.
Select xcell-60-research and start the helicopter route.
Cancel while AppRoot awaits the shared prefetch drain, then release the worker.
findings.impact: Cancellation can admit avoidable synchronous construction before rollback; real helicopter setup cost is source-traced and unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Keep required worker draining, recheck cancellation across that wait and immediately before construction/attachment, then use existing before-candidate rollback.
acceptance: Cancel at the first checkpoint, during drain, on the drain-completion frame and immediately before attachment.
Zero new candidates after cancellation at the drain boundary; Home restored; worker joined; no stale cache publication.
Real helicopter integration under a cold and warm resource cache; repeated cancel and quit.
findings.limits: Actual production AppRoot and loader control flow with a counted stand-in candidate; real helicopter _ready, renderer, audio, loading latency and peak memory were not executed/measured.

findings.title: An explicit aircraft-lighting rig publishes hidden material parameters in mode OFF
findings.impact: Per-frame CPU-side setter traffic survives OFF for an instantiated preset/custom rig. Cost is unmeasured; inherited lighting and selection=disabled have separate behavior.
findings.recommendation: Defer parameters for invisible contributions while preserving logical time/VFX state and synchronously reconciling current values when re-enabled.
acceptance: Compare exact setter counts for OFF, daytime Automatic, NAV, ALL and selection=disabled.
Preserve VFX cue/maneuver histories, residual effects, rewind/reset, skins, emission, gear gates, exposure and multiple views.
Measure paired complete-frame cost on actual target hardware before claiming a gain.
findings.limits: Counter aggregates _set_param calls in one headless synthetic rig. No GPU upload, GPU time, FPS improvement or default-fleet impact established. Do not skip all advance(): it also owns logical lifecycle state.
